subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

The soldiers had __no choice to __report the loss to their commander.
solution:
The correct answer is: **no choice but to**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Add "**but**" as a preposition before "**to report**" to correct the sentence grammatically.
 
• **But **is used as a preposition for joining ideas when the second is different.
 
• The word “**but**' is considered a preposition that means “other than.”
 
• The sentence says the only option left to the soldier was to inform their commander of the loss.
 
• So, '**but**' should be used before '**to**' in order to correct the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is option 4.

 

The correct sentence is: *The soldiers had no choice but to__ report the loss to their commander.*
